# NagarNex — Bengaluru Citizen-Verified Waste Accountability Platform

> Independent citizen initiative for Bengaluru public and municipal waste accountability. Not affiliated with any government or municipal body.

## Overview
NagarNex converts citizen street waste photos into clustered 150m blackspots, requires GPS-matched Before/After photo proof and neighbor consensus to verify clearances, mobilizes 1-click community clean-up micro-drives, and publishes rectified street locations on a public QR board.

## Web Routes
- `/` — Landing Page & 5-Step Accountability Loop
- `/#/map` — Live Bengaluru Blackspot & Collection Center Map + Ward Health Strip
- `/#/intake` — 15-Second AI Waste Intake (EXIF stripped, face/plate privacy check)
- `/#/ward-index` — Bengaluru Ward Improvement Index & CSV Export
- `/#/drives` — Community Clean-Up Micro-Drives & Citizen Impact Passport
- `/#/board` — Public Roadside Rectified Board & Scannable QR Sync

## Serverless API
- `POST /api/vision` — Secure server-side Gemini Vision proxy (`mode: "classify" | "verify"`).
